title: ICCU: In-Context Continual Unlearning via Pattern-Induced Refusal Rules
abstract: arXiv:2605.27138v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific data from trained language models. In real-world deployments, unlearning requests often arrive sequentially, which challenges existing fine-tuning-based methods: fine-tuning each request is costly, accumulates utility loss, and may cause cross-request interference. To address these issues, we propose ICCU (In-Context Continual Unlearning), an in-context continual unlearning framework that induces readable refusal rules from unlearning datasets and applies them at inference time either as a filter or via the system prompt, without modifying model parameters. Because rules are accumulated as an order-independent union, ICCU is compositional and free of cross-request interference, and the original forget-set data can be discarded after rule induction. translated_title: ICCU：基于模式诱导拒绝规则的上下文内持续遗忘
translated_abstract: 机器遗忘旨在从训练好的语言模型中移除特定数据的影响。在现实部署场景中，遗忘请求往往按顺序陆续到达，这对现有基于微调的方法构成了挑战：对每个请求进行微调成本高昂，会累积效用损失，并可能导致跨请求之间的干扰。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ICCU（In-Context Continual Unlearning，上下文内持续遗忘），这是一个上下文内持续遗忘框架，它从遗忘数据集中归纳出可读的拒绝规则，并在推理时通过过滤器或系统提示词的方式应用这些规则，而无需修改模型参数。由于规则以与顺序无关的并集形式累积，ICCU具有可组合性且不存在跨请求干扰，同时原始遗忘集数据在完成规则归纳后即可被丢弃。大量实验表明，ICCU在保持模型效用的同时能够有效抑制目标知识，并可扩展至长序列……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ICCU提出了一种无需修改模型参数的上下文内持续遗忘框架，通过从遗忘数据中归纳可读的拒绝规则并在推理时应用，实现了顺序无关、无跨请求干扰且可丢弃原始遗忘数据的高效持续机器遗忘。
en_tdlr: ICCU proposes a parameter-free in-context continual unlearning framework that induces readable refusal rules from forgetting datasets and applies them at inference time, achieving order-independent, interference-free continual unlearning while allowing the original forget-set data to be discarded.
